units.location: Reagan North Africa Document 341 heading and text
units.exact_text: SUBJECT U.S. Action Against Libyan Terrorism. The telegram states that U.S. officials had confirmation of Libyan-sponsored activity against the U.S. in both Berlin and Paris.

units.location: Reagan North Africa Document 175 legal note
units.exact_text: The text identifies an arrest warrant for Izz-al-Din charging him with hostage taking and conspiracy to commit aircraft piracy and notes a red notice through Interpol.
